title: Awesome Russian Speech: Russian Speech Technology Resources
summary: A comprehensive curated repository of datasets, tools, and open-source models for Russian language speech recognition and synthesis. It is maintained by Alpha Cephei, the team behind the Vosk speech recognition toolkit.
research_notes: Features extensive links to the ru-normalizr tool for text preprocessing and the speechinfo community for Russian ML research updates.

evolution.summary: The list has expanded to include modern neural Text-to-Speech frameworks like Vosk-TTS and Matcha-TTS. It now prioritizes lightweight, offline-first ONNX-powered solutions and integration with Sherpa-ONNX for high-performance streaming ASR on edge devices.
